subject: Startups
title: Canva's Template SEO
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Canva's Template SEO.

hook.text: Search 'birthday card template' on Google. Canva is the top result. That's not luck. It's a growth strategy.

buildup.text: Canva created millions of free design templates. Each template is a landing page optimized for search engines.

discovery.text: Users find Canva through Google, use a free template, then discover the premium features and upgrade.

twist.text: Most design tools gate templates behind paywalls. Canva gives them away, using free content as a top-of-funnel driver.

climax.text: This SEO strategy helped Canva reach 130 million monthly users. Each template works as a silent salesperson.

punchline.text: Every template is a door. Google sends the visitors.

quiz.question: How does Canva use templates for growth?
options: Creates free SEO-optimized landing pages for each
